question: Who took oath as the Chief Minister of Karnataka, in May 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Siddaramaiah**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Siddaramaiah** took oath as the Chief Minister of Karnataka in May 2023.
 
• He is a senior leader of the **Indian National Congress** and has previously served as the Chief Minister of Karnataka from 2013 to 2018.
 
• Siddaramaiah's appointment came after the **2023 Karnataka Legislative Assembly elections**, where the Indian National Congress secured a significant victory.
 
• He was administered the oath of office by the **Governor of Karnataka** at a ceremony held in Bengaluru.
 
• Siddaramaiah's tenure is expected to focus on **developmental policies and inclusive growth** for the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian National Congress** is one of the major political parties in India, founded in 1885.
 
• The party has played a pivotal role in the **Indian independence movement** and has produced several Prime Ministers of India.
 
• The **Chief Minister** is the head of the state government in India, responsible for the administration and governance of the state.
 
• The **Governor** is the constitutional head of the state, appointed by the President of India.
 
• Karnataka is a state in the southwestern region of India, known for its rich cultural heritage and economic development.
